contract: docs/DESIGN.md §7 Direction contract — surface: clinical & revenue-cycle worklists used all shift by physicians, nurses, patient access, pharmacy, lab and coders in US and UK/EU hospitals; job: see who needs action next and act in one or two clicks; primary action per screen is the worklist action (Call/Start, Triage, Administer, Verify, Submit); hierarchy: patient identity + acuity > time pressure > codes/standards > metadata; target viewports 1440x900 (workstation) and 390x844 (phone on rounds).

accessibility.evidence: axe-core 4.10.2 (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A+AA rules) reports 0 violations on 21 distinct screens rendered in the US pack under the roles that use them: Home, Emergency, Inpatient, Ambulatory, Nursing, Laboratory, Pharmacy, Surgery, Imaging, Patients (Physician); Registration, Scheduling, Supply Chain, Module Center, Settings, Interfaces (Administrator); Claims, Billing (HIM coder); Quality, Analytics, Workforce (Executive). Fixed on the way: status text ink darkened for AA (success/danger/warning), danger fill darkened for white text, triage colours retuned, muted text on bed tiles, filter tabs rebuilt as an ARIA radio group (aria-controls pointed at missing panels). Keyboard: Tab reaches the location filter on Registration with a visible focus ring (1440x900-focus.png, 390x844-focus.png); the filter radio group supports Arrow/Home/End. prefers-reduced-motion: the skeleton's motion-safe:animate-pulse resolves to animation-name none. Not audited with tools: the dark (night-shift) theme and the UK pack — reviewed visually only.

responsive.evidence: Home, Emergency and Inpatient rendered at 390x844 and 1440x900 with document scrollWidth − innerWidth = 0 (no horizontal scroll). At 390px the top-bar search collapses to its icon instead of truncating to 'Sea…', stat readouts wrap to two columns, ED cards stack time-to-provider under the patient, and the home header no longer wraps the shift range (shift clock lives only in the top bar). The earlier 14-step end-to-end flow passes at 1440x900 in both the US and UK packs.

loading.evidence: Route chunk held open: a structural skeleton (header, four readouts, six worklist rows) with aria-busy and a polite 'Loading…' live region replaces the old centred spinner, so nothing jumps when the page arrives (1440x900-loading.png, 390x844-loading.png).

empty.evidence: Laboratory → Collect with no specimens due shows 'No orders at this stage' on the chart-paper empty panel while the other stage counters remain visible and selectable (1440x900-empty.png, 390x844-empty.png).

error.evidence: Quality page chunk aborted: the new ErrorBoundary keeps the shell and shows 'This screen could not be downloaded', the cause, the raw error, and Reload / Home; runtime crashes offer Try again / Home / Rebuild demo data and reset on navigation (1440x900-error.png, 390x844-error.png).

partial.evidence: IndexedDB made unavailable (private-window behaviour): the app still loads and works in memory and a status banner states that changes are not being saved on this device and why (1440x900-partial.png). Partial clinical data — e.g. results not yet resulted, failed interface messages — is shown per item on the lab and interface screens.

success.evidence: Registering a clinic visit shows the queue ticket with the HL7 ADT^A04 confirmation plus the eligibility result, with Print ticket and Done as next actions (1440x900-success.png, 390x844-success.png).

permission.evidence: Patient financial services opening the ED board sees 'No access', the role and page named, where an administrator grants it (Settings → Access control), and a Back to home link (1440x900-permission.png, 390x844-permission.png). Modules switched off show a separate 'not turned on' state with a Module Center link for admins.
